description: The Department of Veterans Affairs, Puget Sound VAHCS will be seeking a contractor to provide Regulated Medical Waste disposal service. This will be awarded through a firm fixed price contract.  Solicitation 36C26026Q0390 will be posted on 03/06/2026 and this procurement will be Open Market Unrestricted.  The successful vendor must be licensed and authorized to perform Regulated Medical Waste Disposal statewide by WA Utility and Transportation Commission (UTC)
